rationale: Both Manish and Jiale are deep ML systems builders in San Francisco with complementary expertise: Manish brings applied ML engineering and computer vision work from Meta and Palo Alto Networks, while Jiale focuses on the infrastructure and distributed training systems that power large-scale ML platforms. Their overlapping experience in ML infrastructure and shared Python/PyTorch stack—combined with Jiale's systems-level depth and Manish's domain breadth across cybersecurity AI and LLM tooling—makes them well-positioned to exchange perspectives on production ML challenges.
intro_message: Manish kumar Keshri, meet Jiale Zhi — you're both ML systems engineers in SF who've shipped at Meta, and your work on ML infrastructure and scalable training systems would give you a lot to discuss.
